name: Cursed Crypt

features.name: Cursed Reels
features.description: Curse symbols spread upward and re-roll the covered positions.

features.name: Wrath of Sobek
features.description: Ten free spins with more frequent Curse symbols.

review:
A 5x4 ways game in an Egyptian tomb with one main trick: when a Curse symbol lands, it spreads up to the top of its reel and every cursed spot re-rolls into a random symbol – basically a second chance at a connection.

The Wrath of Sobek bonus gives 10 free spins with more curses, and four scatters unlock the Tomb of Tutankhamun round with extra spins to win. Simpler than most recent Hacksaw games. 10,000x max in every mode.
